feeds.title: Brickset: LEGO set guide and database
feeds.description: Brickset is the best online guide to LEGO sets old and new. It is the best LEGO database on the web, and to keep it updated with news, set information, photos and so on.

feeds.title: Brick Fanatics
feeds.description: Brick Fanatics is the website dedicated to all things LEGO, bringing you the latest news and reviews, as well as the best features and builds from the LEGO community. Brick Fanatics was formed by Richard Hayes in 2010 and is today owned and managed by Tiro Media Ltd.
